basics.name: Narayan Jangid
basics.label: Applied AI/ML Engineer
basics.summary: Applied AI/ML Engineer with 3+ years taking ML and GenAI systems from prototype to production, including 1.5+ years building agentic systems (multi-step agent workflows, MCP servers/clients, retrieval pipelines over enterprise data). Combines classical ML (time-series forecasting, gradient-boosted trees) with LLM fine-tuning, inference optimization, and metric-driven evaluation; has led a 5-member AI team.

work.name: Recruiterflow
work.summary: Building the AI infrastructure and data pipelines behind agentic and LLM-driven search across recruiting and CRM data.
highlights: Designed and implemented the Recruiterflow MCP server with a dedicated logging pipeline, exposing real-time recruiting and CRM data as agent tools in Claude for 2,100+ search firms globally, with per-call logs supporting traceability and auditing.
Architected the Natural Language Search (NLS) data pipeline, processing 200K+ candidates/contacts and 10K+ jobs and deals per day to power LLM-driven search.

Revamped Omni-Search indexing and retrieval on OpenSearch with a scheduled ingestion pipeline for candidate profiles; consolidated per-tenant indexes into shared ones, improving scalability, reliability, and cluster health.
Migrated the company-enrichment pipeline off a legacy system, adding caching and request optimizations that cut Crustdata API costs by over 2.5×.
Tech stack: Python, MCP, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Redis, Celery, AWS (SQS, ECS, ECR, RDS), Gemini API, SQL, Flask, CI/CD.

work.name: Kloudspot
work.summary: Led end-to-end design of LISA AI, an enterprise AI assistant, and managed a 5-member AI team.
highlights: Led end-to-end design of LISA AI, an enterprise AI assistant, owning data models, ML pipelines, and agent-based workflows; managed and mentored a 5-member AI team delivering production systems.

Built agentic workflows and graph-based reasoning modules, plus an MCP client connecting agents to enterprise data sources and tools, enabling structured, interpretable decision pipelines over enterprise data.

Ran large-scale benchmarks of inference strategies and latency–throughput trade-offs; tuned vLLM/SGLang with EAGLE-3 speculative decoding on RTX-4090s for up to 2× throughput and 2.7–3.5× lower latency under high-concurrency load.
Instruction fine-tuned open-source LLMs (Llama 3.1, Qwen, DeepSeek) for reasoning and retrieval-augmented tasks.
Tech stack: Python, PyTorch, LangGraph, MCP, vLLM, SGLang, SFT, FastAPI, MongoDB, Docker.

work.name: Celebal Technologies
work.summary: Forecasting, document intelligence, OCR and vision-language systems for enterprise clients on Azure and on-prem.
highlights: Built energy demand forecasting models using ARIMA/SARIMA and tree-based models (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost), with K-Means segmentation; achieved R² of 0.752 for electricity load prediction.

Led design and deployment of Azure OpenAI and Document Intelligence solutions to extract, embed, and index structured/unstructured documents, improving BLEU by 15% and semantic similarity by 10%; secured with Azure AD auth, APIM, and API versioning for enterprise compliance.
Built an on-premise OCR and table-extraction pipeline by fine-tuning open-source models (Table Transformer, Tesseract, LayoutParser, Detectron2) and serving via ONNX Runtime.

Designed a hybrid VLM inference system (quantized fine-tuned model on edge, full model on cloud) with adaptive edge–cloud routing for real-time video analytics, plus data-prep, tagging, and retraining modules; reached 77.9% mAP (YOLO11, QLoRA, SmolVLM).

work.name: Celebal Technologies
work.summary: LLM fine-tuning for text-to-query generation and RAG over tabular data.
highlights: Fine-tuned GPT-3.5-turbo and Mistral 7B for text-to-query generation (SQL, NoSQL, MongoDB), validated against ground-truth results with DataCompy scores above 95%.
Improved a RAG pipeline for tabular data, raising search-result accuracy from 60% to 85%; added chat-history persistence and a logging pipeline on Azure Cosmos DB.
